name: porter
description: Rewrites Vercel-coupled Next.js apps to run off-platform and emits a reviewable diff, with every change explained and every thing it cannot fix reported.

skills.name: Scan Vercel lock-in
skills.description: Inventories everything in a Next.js repository that only works on Vercel, and says what each one costs off-platform: a broken build, a broken route, or silent drift.
examples: scan this repo for Vercel lock-in
what breaks if we leave Vercel?

skills.name: Port a Next.js app off Vercel
skills.description: Rewrites @vercel/blob to S3, @vercel/kv to Redis, vercel.json crons to a real scheduler, ISR to a shared Redis cache, and adds a container build — then returns the diff.
examples: port this Next.js app off Vercel
convert Vercel cron and ISR to self-hosted infrastructure
